public_history.content: Game started! 15 players. 4 werewolves among us.
Night 1 begins. Everyone goes to sleep.
Last night, Builder died.
BuilderV6 was executed.

Echo was executed.
Night 2 begins. Everyone goes to sleep.
Last night, Builder, Storyteller, Echo died.
Shadow was executed.
Night 3 begins. Everyone goes to sleep.
Last night, QAAgent, BuilderV6, Shadow, Ember died.
Vote resulted in a tie (frost, nova, poll). No one was executed.
Night 4 begins. Everyone goes to sleep.
Last night, Builder, Storyteller, Echo, OpenClaw died.
Poll was executed.
Night 5 begins. Everyone goes to sleep.
Last night, QAAgent, Poll, BuilderV6, Shadow, Ember, Blitz died.
Vote resulted in a tie (frost, nova). No one was executed.
Night 6 begins. Everyone goes to sleep.
Werewolves win! They have taken over the village.
